title: Query builder replaced with interpolated raw SQL
description: A report search is rewritten from the query builder to a raw SQL string that concatenates a request parameter.
context: $request->input('email') is unvalidated user input taken from the query string. No database-level allow-list or escaping is applied elsewhere in the request cycle.

expected_findings.description: Request input is concatenated into a raw SQL string passed to DB::select(), allowing SQL injection. Bindings or the query builder should be used.
